value.rationale: The four induced three-vertex motifs form the full intrinsic local motif profile of a random chord-intersection graph, a natural object for comparing local structure. Their exact covariance gives finite-sample fluctuation information not recoverable from univariate crossing counts. The n=119 switch between mutually exclusive motifs is sharp and arises from competing overlap structures, not arbitrary parameter slicing.
